		icon = APL_cheat
		visible = {
			original_tag = APL
		}
		cost = 0
		complete_effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = APL_veil_intact } }

			custom_effect_tooltip = APL_cheat_veil_tt

		}
